newsitem.title: USA: Celgene says SYNOVIR trial results good.
newsitem.headline: Celgene says SYNOVIR trial results good.

text.p: Celgene Corp said Tuesday that data from its Phase II/III trial of SYNOVIR in HIV-associated weight loss showed "a statistically significant positive result" in reaching the trial's primary endpoint, change in body weight after eight weeks of therapy.

Based on these results, which expand on earlier reported positive results, Celgene said it reconfirmed plans to submit a New Drug Application with the Food and Drug Administration for the use of thalidomide in AIDS wasting later this year.

The double-blind placebo-controlled trial evaluated 99 HIV-positive patients who had lost an average of more than 10 percent of their body weight with no explanatory factors for their weight loss other than HIV infection, Celgene said.
